description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Twin Element Mode III (Lightning, Wind)], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Ability Berserk] and [Wildling Mode] to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode III (Lightning, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Wind 2 with Stacking] after using a Lightning/Wind ability

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Ability Berserk
description.text: Forces a random available action excluding Defend, affects targeting (single: random enemy/ally; group: all enemies/allies if the action's auto-target group is enemies/allies), Berserk, Confuse, Paralyze, Stop are prioritized

description.name: Wildling Mode
description.text: Grants [Wildling Lightning Ability +15/30/50% Boost]/[Wildling Wind Ability +15/30/50% Boost] after using 1/2/3+ Lightning or Wind abilities if the triggering ability deals Lightning/Wind damage
